userId.description: User ID of the session owner

taskTitle.description: Title or subject of the focus session

mode.description: Study mode name e.g. Deep Work, Classic, Short Sprint

startTime.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when session started

endTime.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when session ended

distractionsCount.description: Number of distraction intercepts during the session

focusPointsEarned.description: Focus points earned for the session

dayOfWeek.description: Day of week (1 Mon to 7 Sun)
